'''UK2-B''' was a [[droid]] that was active during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> the droid escorted two [[Gamorrean Warrior|Gamorrean guards]] through the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[Boba Fett]] and presented them to the newly-risen [[crime lord]], watching intently as Fett chose to spare the prisoners' lives. UK2-B had [[Color|brown]] and grey plating and a red [[sensor]].<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" />

==Behind the scenes==
UK2-B appeared in the [[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land|first episode]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> on [[December 29]], [[2021]].<ref name="Release date">{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}}</ref> [[Chris Bartlett]] was credited in the episode as the performance artist of UK2-B, though it was not immediately clear which character in the episode this credit referred to. The episode also featured a different droid, [[8D8]], that was voiced by actor [[Matt Berry]].<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land" /> Some fans and online publications assumed that Berry's character was in fact UK2-B,<ref name="Cinemaholic Article">{{WebCite|url=https://thecinemaholic.com/what-is-uk2-b-in-the-book-of-boba-fett-does-matt-perry-voice-the-droid|text=What is UK2-B in The Book of Boba Fett? Does Matt Perry Voice the Droid?|author=Kundu, Tamal|date=2021-12-30|archivedate=20211230090935}}</ref><ref name="HITC Article">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hitc.com/en-gb/2021/12/30/uk2-b|text=Who Voices UK2-B in The Book of Boba Fett? Character Explained|author=Weston, Christopher|archivedate=20211230113640}}</ref> prompting [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] to clarify the identity of Bartlett's character on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]].<ref name="Hidalgo Identification Tweet" />

The costume Bartlett wore in ''The Book of Boba Fett'' was originally designed for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', where it was used in scenes set on the planet [[Jedha]]. This version of the costume featured a different design for the droid's legs, necessitating that the performance artist walk on stilts for the role. Hidalgo described this droid as being of a "similar model" to that of UK2-B.<ref name="Hidalgo Rogue One Tweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1480455207003639808|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=A different droid of a similar model as UK2-B was known to be on Jedha. The one on Tatooine had sturdier legs.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/t36yJ}}</ref>
